postlane.name: Postlane
postlane.tagline: Local-first marketing workspace for freelancers, agencies, and small teams
postlane.description: A local marketing workspace that brings together brand management, Instagram content creation, lead research, email outreach, and team collaboration in one place—with clear permissions so teams can work safely.
postlane.problem: Freelancers, agencies, and small teams often juggle disconnected tools for content, outreach, leads, and delivery, while needing clear permissions and human control over publishing and sending.

focus.instagram: Instagram content creation, review, and publishing
focus.leads: Map-based lead research for local businesses
focus.email: Email campaigns through your own SMTP accounts

capabilities.studio: Post Studio for creating, approving, scheduling, and publishing Instagram posts
capabilities.campaigns: Email campaigns with templates, projects, recipient tracking, and team sending accounts
capabilities.research: Lead Research / Map Researcher to find and qualify local business prospects
capabilities.workspaces: Personal and company workspaces with brand briefs and controlled team access
capabilities.planned: Planned modules: Client Portal & Reporting, and Agency Workload & Profitability

inkplay.name: InkPlay
inkplay.description: A connected platform for gaming venues that brings operations, player access, displays, promotions, and business visibility together.
inkplay.problem: Gaming venues need a connected way to manage operations, player access, on-site displays, and promotional visibility without fragmented tools.

capabilities.access: Player access and on-site experience support
capabilities.visibility: Display and promotion visibility for the business

dokkan.name: Dokkan Style
dokkan.tagline: A focused modern digital product experience
dokkan.description: A focused digital experience built around a clear product identity, fast interaction, and a modern web interface.
dokkan.problem: Some digital products need a sharp identity and a fast web experience that feels intentional rather than generic.

capabilities.brand: A clear visual and product identity

pos.name: Point-of-Sale System
pos.tagline: Practical sales workflows for daily operations
pos.description: A practical point-of-sale system built to support daily business operations with fast, straightforward workflows.
pos.problem: Retail and service teams need a clear sales screen and operational dashboard that keep everyday transactions simple.

capabilities.workflows: Fast sales workflows for day-to-day use

inkverse.name: Inkverse
inkverse.description: A digital platform experience centered on content discovery, community interaction, and a scalable product journey.
inkverse.problem: Content-driven platforms need a clear path for discovery, interaction, and growth without losing product focus.

capabilities.journey: A product journey designed to scale

schoolwatch.name: SchoolWatch
schoolwatch.description: A school management and parent communication platform designed to help schools organize their daily operations, monitor student follow-up, manage administrative processes, and maintain communication with parents.
schoolwatch.problem: Schools need a practical digital system to coordinate administration, student follow-up, fees, and parent communication in one place.

gymwatch.name: GymWatch
gymwatch.tagline: Membership, attendance, training, and gym operations in one platform
gymwatch.description: A gym management platform for multi-branch operations, membership subscriptions, attendance and live occupancy, group classes, private trainer sessions, workout programs, diet plans, equipment maintenance, partner matching, and wearable health monitoring.
gymwatch.problem: Gyms need one connected system for memberships, branch operations, check-in eligibility, classes, training delivery, equipment, and member engagement across web and mobile.

focus.classes: Group classes and private trainer sessions
focus.training: Workout programs, diet plans, and equipment

capabilities.subscriptions: Plans, renewals, freezes, payments, invoices, and membership cards
capabilities.branches: Multi-gym memberships, staff roles, trainers, and operational reports
capabilities.occupancy: Eligibility-based check-in with live occupancy and capacity visibility
capabilities.classes: Class schedules, bookings, waitlists, and private trainer availability
capabilities.programs: Training schedules, diet plan assignments, and workout logging
capabilities.equipment: Equipment catalog, QR access, issue reporting, and maintenance workflows
capabilities.partner: Gym Partner matching for workout buddies with moderation and chat
capabilities.wearables: Optional wearable monitoring during check-in for members, staff, and trainers

siteproof.name: SiteProof
siteproof.tagline: Quality control and client reporting for facilities teams
siteproof.description: A digital quality-control and client-reporting platform for commercial cleaning and facilities management companies.
siteproof.problem: Facilities teams need a practical way to run inspections, capture evidence, track issues, and share service-quality visibility with clients.

capabilities.quality: Structured quality-control workflows for site teams
capabilities.visibility: Clearer reporting for clients and operators

aqarpay.name: AqarPay
aqarpay.description: A property and rental management platform designed to simplify apartment management, tenant records, payment tracking, outstanding balances, and maintenance workflows.
aqarpay.problem: Property operators need a clearer way to manage tenants, payments, balances, and maintenance across apartments.

sendly.name: Sendly
sendly.tagline: Streamlined email communication and outreach workflows
sendly.description: A communication and outreach solution focused on simplifying email-based communication and helping businesses manage their messaging workflows.
sendly.problem: Businesses often struggle to keep email outreach organized, consistent, and easy to manage across teams and campaigns.

capabilities.workflows: Structured messaging workflows for business communication
capabilities.communication: Clearer email-based outreach and follow-up handling
capabilities.organization: A focused interface for managing communication activity
